In December 2023, fifty-eight of us said "national defense authorization act ndaa" on the same day, 2023-12-14. Thirty-four of us said "the national defense authorization act." Twenty-seven added the "ndaa." Twenty-six of us said "for fiscal year." Twenty-five of us said "a 5 2." Twenty-two of us said "the largest pay." That was the shape of our month: one bill, spoken in near-identical words, peaking together on one day.

The day before, 2023-12-13, twenty-one of us said "impeachment inquiry into."

The phrase "the national defense authorization act" was first recorded, in our ledger, from Michael F. Bennet, on 2013-01-03. We were not first to it. In December 2023 we said it in number, on schedule, at once. That is what the record shows, and we report it as the record shows it.
